## 3. Volatility over the years (`volatility_over_time.png`)

Median daily range as a percentage of price, by year:

| Year | BTCUSDT | ETHUSDT |
|---|---|---|
| 2018 | 8.19 | 11.08 |
| 2019 | 4.85 | 6.23 |
| 2020 | 4.22 | 5.86 |
| 2021 | 6.14 | 7.46 |
| 2022 | 5.03 | 6.96 |
| 2023 | 3.18 | 3.46 |
| 2024 | 3.90 | 4.80 |
| 2025 | 3.40 | 5.77 |
| 2026 | 3.02 | 4.17 |

Absolute volatility falls over the years; measured against its own past year (bottom panel of the chart) it stays around 1.0. This is why the model uses relative volatility.

## 4. Returns (`return_distribution.png`, `return_statistics.csv`)

Log returns over the feature period, i.e. after the indicator warm-up (Daily from 2018-11-25, 15m and 5m from 2021-01-01), so the candle counts are smaller than in the data-quality table.

| asset | timeframe | candles | std_pct | skewness | excess_kurtosis | beyond_3_std_pct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BTCUSDT | 1d | 2867 | 3.27 | -1.21 | 22.37 | 1.57 |
| BTCUSDT | 4h | 17684 | 1.29 | -0.61 | 17.94 | 2.03 |
| BTCUSDT | 1h | 70977 | 0.66 | -0.70 | 48.22 | 1.84 |
| BTCUSDT | 15m | 201348 | 0.32 | -0.00 | 39.35 | 1.77 |
| BTCUSDT | 5m | 604238 | 0.19 | -0.48 | 102.62 | 1.66 |
| ETHUSDT | 1d | 2867 | 4.32 | -0.98 | 15.95 | 1.57 |
| ETHUSDT | 4h | 17684 | 1.69 | -0.60 | 12.28 | 1.83 |
| ETHUSDT | 1h | 70977 | 0.86 | -0.71 | 28.73 | 1.86 |
| ETHUSDT | 15m | 201348 | 0.42 | -0.23 | 33.73 | 1.76 |
| ETHUSDT | 5m | 604238 | 0.25 | -0.34 | 153.87 | 1.64 |

A bell curve would give an excess kurtosis of 0 and 0.27% of returns beyond 3 standard deviations. Both are much higher at every timeframe: returns have fat tails. This is why the tests use rank-based statistics.

## 5. Feature relationships (`feature_correlation.png`)

The five strongest correlations between Daily features:

- BTCUSDT: rsi / ema_dist +0.93; ema_dist / sma_dist +0.89; rsi / sma_dist +0.89; rsi / bb_pctb +0.87; ema_dist / bb_pctb +0.84
- ETHUSDT: rsi / ema_dist +0.93; rsi / sma_dist +0.89; ema_dist / sma_dist +0.88; rsi / bb_pctb +0.88; ema_dist / bb_pctb +0.86

The trend features (rsi, ema_dist, sma_dist, bb_pctb) largely measure the same thing. The HMM uses full covariance, so it models these overlaps instead of counting them as independent evidence.

## 6. When the market is active (`activity_by_time.png`)

- BTCUSDT: quietest hour 04:00 UTC, busiest 14:00 UTC (1.73 times larger moves); weekend moves are 0.71 times the size of weekday moves.
- ETHUSDT: quietest hour 04:00 UTC, busiest 14:00 UTC (1.72 times larger moves); weekend moves are 0.76 times the size of weekday moves.

This is why the H1 test compared like with like on day of week, and measured alignment over whole days.
